name: Terraria (tModLoader)
author: aetheris-project
description: Terraria dedicated server with optional tModLoader support, world auto-creation and configurable difficulty.

installation.script:
# @author Aetheris Project
# @description Terraria install script
# @user-alpine

apt-get update -y
apt-get install -y curl unzip jq

# Resolve latest stable Terraria server
TERRARIA_URL=$(curl -s https://terraria.org/api/get/dedicated-servers-native | jq -r '.[0].url')
if [ -z "${TERRARIA_URL}" ]; then
  echo "Could not resolve the Terraria server URL." >&2
  exit 1
fi
curl -s -o terraria.zip "${TERRARIA_URL}"
unzip -o terraria.zip -d .
rm -f terraria.zip

cat > start.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# tModLoader 64-bit Linux server launcher
cd /home/container
if [ -f tModLoaderServer ]; then
  chmod +x tModLoaderServer
  exec ./tModLoaderServer "$@"
else
  chmod +x TerrariaServer.bin.x86_64
  exec ./TerrariaServer.bin.x86_64 "$@"
fi
EOF
chmod +x start.sh

mkdir -p worlds logs
cat > serverconfig.txt <<EOF
port=${SERVER_PORT:-7777}
maxplayers=${MAX_PLAYERS:-16}
worldpath=./worlds
worldname=${WORLD_NAME:-Aetheris}
autocreate=${WORLD_SIZE:-3}
difficulty=${DIFFICULTY:-0}
EOF

variables.name: World Path
variables.description: Path to the world file inside the container.

variables.name: World Name
variables.description: Name of the world file (without extension).
